interface_change.owner: svc (hbm-phys/[svc]) + die lead (ot_hgi_dma_slot / die top nets)
interface_change.summary: DMA BACK needs an svc WRITE stream into each stack's service, the mirror of the DMA FRONT read stream (dq/dd/dd_cr).
interface_change.engines_ports: ot_hgi_dma_engines #(.BACK(1)): output wd[32*289-1:0], input wd_cr[31:0], input wa[15:0]; the back engine shares the existing VM DMA wide READ group (vr2q 513 / vr2r 8,257, die nets hgi_vmr2_dma / _r) with the mover (ownership switched in the engines)

die_nets.dma_wd: 4 stacks x 8 lanes x 289 b = 9,248 wires, DMA slot -> svc strip, {v [288], sector address [287:256] = HBM byte address [36:5] (stack bits [31:30] must equal the lane's stack), data [255:0]}; registered at the engine; relay registers every <= 500 um as dd
die_nets.dma_wd_cr: 32 wires svc -> DMA slot: one pulse = the svc popped one beat of that lane (credit return); initial credit WCR = 32 a lane (the svc's beat buffer depth; >= the credit round trip: 4 + 2 x hops + svc pop cycles)
die_nets.dma_wa: 4 stacks x 4 b svc -> DMA slot: sectors of that stack written this cycle (0..8), posted acknowledgements (the write is visible to every later read of the stack's controller); pin-flopped in the engine

interface_change.svc_side: per stack: 8 lane beat FIFOs (WCR deep), each beat is self-describing (no request / tag / order: any lane, any order); the 8 lanes of a stack carry up to 8 sectors a cycle, normally one 256 B contiguous chunk (8 consecutive sectors) -> one 256 B write burst a cycle a stack; count written sectors into dma_wa. Model: tb_hgi_e2e.sv hgi_e2e_svcw (write at arrival, credit HOPS later, wa LAT later).
interface_change.loader_die: ot_hfd_loader_hgi instantiates ot_hgi_dma_engines with BACK = 0 (ports unconnected); enabling BACK there = connect wd / wd_cr / wa to the svc write stream and set BACK = 1.
interface_change.b2: HBM B2 (owner 10-12): one ot_hgi_dma_back per cluster beside its local slice, NS 1 / NB 8. VM side = the cluster's local 8-lane group client tap (rup 129 = {c_req, 8 x {v, sector 15}}, rdn 2,065 = {c_gnt, credits 8, 8 x {v, data 256}}). svc side inside the cluster: dma_wd 8 x 289, dma_wd_cr 8, dma_wa 4 (own stack only). No cross-cluster wires.
interface_change.b2_compiler: B2 compiler item (lead acked): the STRIPE4 h swap (ds_mtp_kernels swap(), 320 x 256 B rows, row o on stack o mod 4) must be emitted as 4 per-cluster DMA.STOREs (cluster k: its 80 rows from its slice, linear on stack k at COLB + slot x CSTR + k x 64, stride 256), and the swapin as 4 per-cluster loads.

native_b2_swap.allocation_decision: CLOSED 2026-10-13: h goes on the slot BY OWNER. The B2 allocator holds h where the layer's split records compute on it (cluster q = the contiguous quarter, logical rows 80q..80q+79; committed DS L14 placement LOCAL q, phys 0, stride 64). Native layout: slot row q+4j on stack q <- logical row 80q+j. If the die's svc read latency is above 43 cycles the swap-in is over 1.10x and the structural fix is in the front (issue the next windows while the first is in flight), not in S.
